title: Message signing for Trezor and Ledger (CIP-8, CIP30)

ms.promise:
1) We will develop the code and prepare PRs for off-chain message signing for Trezor firmware and for Trezor Connect (integration layer). 
2) The PRs will be reviewed internally and by Trezor security team and will be ready for the release process.
ms.criteria:
1) A compiled version of our Trezor firmware can sign off-chain messages as specified in CIP-8 and CIP30.
2) The PRs are submitted to Trezor Github repository and reviewed by Trezor. All issues and comments from code review are resolved.
ms.report:
PR for Trezor firmware https://github.com/trezor/trezor-firmware/pull/3509
PR for Trezor connect https://github.com/trezor/trezor-suite/pull/10970
Demo video - ASCII message confirmation flow https://drive.google.com/file/d/1x1ewOvVK8ZyZ4Qqklh9kMV0aUqK2w5DJ/view?usp=sharing
Demo video - non-ASCII message confirmation flow https://drive.google.com/file/d/17H3tn4RhLPR499oYx41E9yG-PkriI7SD/view?usp=sharing

ms.promise:
1) We will develop the code and prepare PRs for off-chain message signing for Ledger cardano BOLOS application and for cardano-ledger-js (integration layer). 
2) The PRs will be reviewed internally and ready for security review by the external auditor
ms.criteria:
1) A compiled version of our Ledger firmware can sign off-chain messages as specified in CIP-8 and CIP30.
2) The PRs are submitted to the Ledger Github (Ledger app) and Vacuumlabs LedgerJS (Cardano-ledger-JS) repositories ready to be reviewed by the external auditor.
ms.report:
We finalized Ledger portion of work quite some time ago. As we also already passed the audit (Milestone 4), we are now waiting for Ledger to release (Milestone 5). Unfortunately, Ledger is very slow with reviewing and releasing nowadays.

ms.promise:
1) Integrate off-chain message signing functionality of Ledger and Trezor with cardano-hw-cli tool https://github.com/vacuumlabs/cardano-hw-cli
Note: Milestones 3,4,5 may be delivered in mixed order as they contain external dependencies that are not under our control (external auditor availability, Trezor and Ledger review and release process speed, etc.)
ms.criteria: 1) A compiled version of our updated cardano-hw-cli tool can sign off-chain messages as specified in CIP-8 and CIP30 with both Ledger and Trezor.
ms.report:
We finalized the support for message signing in cardano-hw-cli. This was also successfully tested by M Lang using his suite for stake pool operators https://github.com/gitmachtl/cardano-signer
